items.action: Action: M/S/Failed (Ishii/Lunaparra) to adopt Resolutions for Seating Assignments, Vice-President Rotation, 4x6 Committee Alternate, and Representative Appointments as revised in Supplemental Communications Packet #2 by Mayor Ishii to add the AC Transit-City of Berkeley Inter-Agency Liaison Committee appointments and further amended on the dais to switch the appointments of Councilmembers Bartlett and Blackaby on the Public Safety Committee and the Land Use Housing and Economic Development Committee. Vote: Ayes – O’Keefe, Lunaparra, Ishii; Noes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Blackaby, Humbert; Abstain – Tregub; Absent – Bartlett Action: Moved to Action Calendar. 0 speakers. M/S/Carried (Taplin/Kesarwani) to: 1. Adopt Resolution No. 71,652–N.S. (Seating Assignments) 2. Adopt Resolution No. 71,653–N.S. (Vice-President Rotation) amended to change the rotation order to be determined by length of tenure starting from longest to shortest and to break ties in tenure with the higher number of votes received in the previous election. 3. Adopt Resolution No. 71,654–N.S. (4x6 Committee Alternate) 4. Adopt Resolution No. 71,655–N.S. (Representative Appointments) as revised in Supplemental Communications Packet #2 by Mayor Ishii to add the AC Transit-City of Berkeley Inter-Agency Liaison Committee appointment; further amended on the dais to switch the appointments of Councilmembers Bartlett and Blackaby on the Public Safety Committee and the Land Use Housing and Economic Development Committee; and further amended on the dais to switch the appointments of Councilmembers Humbert and Lunaparra on the Agenda & Rules Committee and the Land Use Housing and Economic Development Committee Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Tregub, Blackaby, Humbert; Noes – O’Keefe, Lunaparra, Ishii, Abstain – None; Absent – Bartlett.
